youtube_description:
Derren Brown's extraordinary television shows have re-defined magic, illusion and psychological manipulation, while Nina Conti’s unique act combines superb ventriloquism with the art of comedy. 

Both performers use time-honoured techniques and could have comfortably graced the earlier theatres celebrated in the British Library’s ‘Victorian Entertainments: There Will Be Fun’ exhibition. 

These two talented and contrasting performers discuss their stage craft with co-curator of our #BLVictorianFun exhibition, Christopher Green.
